title: ModelExtractionResponse
description: The ONE top-level contract for a model extraction response. A JSON object whose only key is 'candidates': an array of model-extraction-payload objects. Multiple claims use multiple array elements. A document with no extractable claims yields {"candidates": []}. A bare payload object or a top-level array is INVALID — it is rejected, never silently converted. Pipeline metadata (candidate_id, candidate_sha256, document_id, model_*, *_sha256, extracted_at) is generated by the pipeline and must never appear here.

candidates.description: Zero or more candidate claims extracted from the document.
